title: On the Spectral Region of 4-Cycle Stochastic Matrices
summary: We study the spectrum of 4-cycle row-stochastic matrices. For real eigenvalues the spectral region is [-1,1]. For nonreal eigenvalues a+ib we derive necessary conditions in terms of the real and imaginary parts, including the inequality a+|b| = 0. We also prove conversely that every point in the corresponding interior region occurs as an eigenvalue of a 4-cycle matrix. The proof is organized through a reformulation of the characteristic equation, an argument parametrization, a convex-analytic criterion, and explicit boundary constructions.
